informal_statement: If a regular matroid is a 2-sum of binary matroids, then both of the matroids being summed (the summands) are also regular.
informal_proof: Given that the entire matroid formed by the 2-sum is regular and that both summands are binary matroids, we can deduce the regularity of each summand individually. By examining the properties that define the regularity of the combined matroid and applying those properties to each summand separately, we conclude that each summand matroid must also be regular.

id.name: TwoSumAssumptions.decomposition_isRegular_both
id.content:
/-- If a regular matroid is a 2-sum of binary matroids, both summand matroids are regular. -/
lemma TwoSumAssumptions.decomposition_isRegular_both {M₁ M₂ : Matroid α}
    (assumptions : TwoSumAssumptions M₁ M₂) (regularity : assumptions.build2sum.IsRegular) :
    M₁.IsRegular ∧ M₂.IsRegular :=
  ⟨assumptions.decomposition_isRegular_left regularity, assumptions.decomposition_isRegular_right regularity⟩
